protocolRefs.multiCallChain: DOM XML document lifecycle: create/parse ref -> navigate/get/set elements and attributes -> export/close

constraints: childValue's contents are always converted to text before insertion.

If elementRef designates the Document node (top level), a Doctype node is inserted before any other node; processing instructions and comments are always inserted before the root node (but after any Doctype node).

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Appends a new child node (comment, processing instruction, CDATA, DATA, DOCTYPE, or ELEMENT) with the given value to an XML node, returning a reference to the new child. The node kind is selected by the childType constant (one of the 'XML' theme values: comment=2, processing instruction=3, DATA=6, CDATA=7, DOCTYPE=10, ELEMENT=11).
